notes: Privacy tab: the optional settings that have a trade-off are now flagged clearly in orange with a '⚠ Check first' tag and a plain-English warning (e.g. 'Turn off location tracking' shows it also disables Find My Device). These are the ones left un-ticked — the pre-ticked Recommended items are all safe and reversible. Also added a 'Turn off Windows Copilot' option for Windows 11 (separate from Cortana — turning off Cortana does not affect Copilot).
